# agent-ready-poc

> Practitioner-to-practitioner AI advancement firm for skilled-trades and local-service businesses. Three concrete services: dispatch automation, estimate acceleration, field-tech copilot. Fixed-scope engagements with production handoff in 4–8 weeks.

> Brand name + founder backstory placeholder pending Checkpoint 4. Site structure, services, engagement model, and FAQ are real.
